I am an old woman of seventy years, and this small maize plot near my house is only a tiny piece of my land. I have no schooling and little cash, so I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer — maybe just a small bit of DAP and urea if the cooperative gives it on credit, but not much. I will put the manure from my animals on this plot because it is close to the house, and I will plant the seed I saved from last harvest like I always do. For such a small plot my children and grandchildren help me weed, and I do not hire anyone because I have no money for that.
